title: Each reader handles a closed PR that another open PR carries, so any carried PR can close at once
why: The owner wants every PR held by another open PR closed at once, reviewed or not (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST Nov 9). Today the close-replaced-at-open lane closes only done PRs, because four readers lose a closed PR.
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Readers that lose a closed carried PR: (1) `merge --reviewed` reads open PRs only; (2) skills/roadmap/build.py `unlaned`/`lane_live` flags a doing step whose only PR is closed and whose carrier sits on an integration branch (exit 1); (3) hooks/guard_merge.py, near line 1300, refuses an archive with the wrong text until the carrier merges; (4) settings.json lines 52 and 59 match no carried close. Done check: each reader handles a closed carried PR, then the close extends to any held PR. Source: lane close-replaced-at-open 22:15 CST, relayed by the coordinator 22:16 CST. Round 3 limits of #2500 (coordinator 00:59 CST Nov 10): (1) a lane dropped from an integration PR stays closed until the runner removes its `Replaces #N` line and reopens it; a `Carried by` note with the carrier open prints no reopen line; ci-hygiene step 8 needs one sentence for the drop (most likely to bite). (2) a PR named by `Replaces #N` leaves the batch line without a head check. (3) `Replaces #N` has no sentence check ("Replaces #2481 approach..." closes #2481). (4) a reopen line repeats each wake if the owner closed the PR on purpose. (5) unknown: whether a close line counts as naming the PR under the PR-housekeeping allow.
